*Filtro de Dosificación*

Selecciona el rango de tiempo:

parameters.query:
=WITH actual_logs AS (
  SELECT 
    m.id, 
    m.status::text AS status, 
    m."scheduledAt", 
    m.zones, 
    COALESCE(a.name, 'Aplicación Manual') AS "agrochemicalName",
    a.purpose::text AS "agrochemicalPurpose",
    COALESCE(fp.name, pp.name, s.name, 'Aplicación Manual Independiente') AS "programName",
    a."isMix",
    a."dosageValue",
    CASE a."dosageUnit"::text 
      WHEN 'ML_L' THEN 'mL/L' 
      WHEN 'G_L' THEN 'g/L' 
      WHEN 'CDA_L' THEN 'cda/L' 
      WHEN 'CDITA_L' THEN 'cdta/L' 
      WHEN 'PORCENTAJE' THEN '%' 
      WHEN 'GOTAS_L' THEN 'gotas/L' 
      WHEN 'CC_L' THEN 'cc/L' 
      ELSE a."dosageUnit"::text 
    END AS agrochemical_unit,
    COALESCE(
      (
        SELECT json_agg(
          json_build_object(
            'name', ing.name,
            'dosageValue', mi."dosageValue",
            'dosageUnit', CASE mi."dosageUnit"::text 
              WHEN 'ML_L' THEN 'mL/L' 
              WHEN 'G_L' THEN 'g/L' 
              WHEN 'CDA_L' THEN 'cda/L' 
              WHEN 'CDITA_L' THEN 'cdta/L' 
              WHEN 'PORCENTAJE' THEN '%' 
              WHEN 'GOTAS_L' THEN 'gotas/L' 
              WHEN 'CC_L' THEN 'cc/L' 
              ELSE mi."dosageUnit"::text 
            END
          ) 
          ORDER BY mi."dosageValue" DESC
        ) 
        FROM "AgrochemicalMixItem" mi 
        JOIN "Agrochemical" ing ON mi."ingredientId" = ing.id 
        WHERE mi."parentMixId" = a.id
      ),
      '[]'::json
    ) AS ingredients
  FROM "DosingLog" m 
  LEFT JOIN "DosingSchedule" s ON m."scheduleId" = s.id
  LEFT JOIN "FertilizationProgram" fp ON s."fertilizationProgramId" = fp.id
  LEFT JOIN "PhytosanitaryProgram" pp ON s."phytosanitaryProgramId" = pp.id
  LEFT JOIN "Agrochemical" a ON m."agrochemicalId" = a.id
), 
routine_schedules AS (
  SELECT 
    s.id, 
    'PENDING' AS status, 
    (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Caracas' + INTERVAL '5 days')::timestamp AS "scheduledAt", 
    s.zones, 
    COALESCE(fa.name, pa.name, s.name) AS "agrochemicalName",
    COALESCE(fa.purpose::text, pa.purpose::text, 'DESARROLLO') AS "agrochemicalPurpose",
    COALESCE(fp.name, pp.name, s.name) AS "programName",
    COALESCE(fa."isMix", pa."isMix", false) AS "isMix",
    COALESCE(fa."dosageValue", pa."dosageValue") AS "dosageValue",
    CASE COALESCE(fa."dosageUnit"::text, pa."dosageUnit"::text) 
      WHEN 'ML_L' THEN 'mL/L' 
      WHEN 'G_L' THEN 'g/L' 
      WHEN 'CDA_L' THEN 'cda/L' 
      WHEN 'CDITA_L' THEN 'cdta/L' 
      WHEN 'PORCENTAJE' THEN '%' 
      WHEN 'GOTAS_L' THEN 'gotas/L' 
      WHEN 'CC_L' THEN 'cc/L' 
      ELSE COALESCE(fa."dosageUnit"::text, pa."dosageUnit"::text) 
    END AS agrochemical_unit,
    COALESCE(
      (
        SELECT json_agg(
          json_build_object(
            'name', ing.name,
            'dosageValue', mi."dosageValue",
            'dosageUnit', CASE mi."dosageUnit"::text 
              WHEN 'ML_L' THEN 'mL/L' 
              WHEN 'G_L' THEN 'g/L' 
              WHEN 'CDA_L' THEN 'cda/L' 
              WHEN 'CDITA_L' THEN 'cdta/L' 
              WHEN 'PORCENTAJE' THEN '%' 
              WHEN 'GOTAS_L' THEN 'gotas/L' 
              WHEN 'CC_L' THEN 'cc/L' 
              ELSE mi."dosageUnit"::text 
            END
          ) 
          ORDER BY mi."dosageValue" DESC
        ) 
        FROM "AgrochemicalMixItem" mi 
        JOIN "Agrochemical" ing ON mi."ingredientId" = ing.id 
        WHERE mi."parentMixId" = COALESCE(fa.id, pa.id)
      ),
      '[]'::json
    ) AS ingredients 
  FROM "DosingSchedule" s 
  LEFT JOIN "FertilizationProgram" fp ON s."fertilizationProgramId" = fp.id 
  LEFT JOIN "FertilizationCycle" fc ON fc."programId" = fp.id AND fc.sequence = 1 
  LEFT JOIN "Agrochemical" fa ON fc."agrochemicalId" = fa.id 
  LEFT JOIN "PhytosanitaryProgram" pp ON s."phytosanitaryProgramId" = pp.id 
  LEFT JOIN "PhytosanitaryCycle" pc ON pc."programId" = pp.id AND pc.sequence = 1 
  LEFT JOIN "Agrochemical" pa ON pc."agrochemicalId" = pa.id 
  WHERE s."isEnabled" = true 
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM "DosingLog" ml 
      WHERE ml."scheduleId" = s.id 
        AND ml.status IN ('PENDING'::"TaskStatus", 'WAITING_CONFIRMATION'::"TaskStatus")
    )
), 
all_tasks AS (
  SELECT * FROM actual_logs 
  UNION ALL 
  SELECT * FROM routine_schedules
) 
SELECT * FROM all_tasks 
WHERE ('{{ $json.statusPreset }}' = 'all' 
       OR ('{{ $json.statusPreset }}' = 'PENDING' AND (status = 'PENDING' OR status = 'WAITING_CONFIRMATION'))
       OR status = '{{ $json.statusPreset }}') 
  AND ('{{ $json.timePreset }}' = 'all' 
       OR ('{{ $json.timePreset }}' = 'today' AND "scheduledAt" >= CURRENT_DATE AND "scheduledAt" < CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '1 day') 
       OR ('{{ $json.timePreset }}' = 'week' AND "scheduledAt" >= date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE) AND "scheduledAt" < date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 week') 
       OR ('{{ $json.timePreset }}' = 'next-week' AND "scheduledAt" >= date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 week' AND "scheduledAt" < date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '2 weeks') 
       OR ('{{ $json.timePreset }}' = 'month' AND "scheduledAt" >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) AND "scheduledAt" < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 month') 
       OR ('{{ $json.timePreset }}' = 'next-month' AND "scheduledAt" >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 month' AND "scheduledAt" < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '2 months')) 
ORDER BY "scheduledAt" DESC 
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
  d.id, 
  d.purpose, 
  d.zones, 
  d."scheduledAt", 
  d.status, 
  s.name AS schedule_name, 
  COALESCE(fp.name, pp.name, s.name) AS program_name, 
  a.name AS agrochemical_name, 
  a.purpose::text AS agrochemical_purpose, 
  a."isMix",
  a."dosageValue",
  CASE a."dosageUnit"::text 
    WHEN 'ML_L' THEN 'mL/L' 
    WHEN 'G_L' THEN 'g/L' 
    WHEN 'CDA_L' THEN 'cda/L' 
    WHEN 'CDITA_L' THEN 'cdta/L' 
    WHEN 'PORCENTAJE' THEN '%' 
    WHEN 'GOTAS_L' THEN 'gotas/L' 
    WHEN 'CC_L' THEN 'cc/L' 
    ELSE a."dosageUnit"::text 
  END AS agrochemical_unit,
  COALESCE(
    (
      SELECT json_agg(
        json_build_object(
          'name', ing.name,
          'dosageValue', mi."dosageValue",
          'dosageUnit', CASE mi."dosageUnit"::text 
            WHEN 'ML_L' THEN 'mL/L' 
            WHEN 'G_L' THEN 'g/L' 
            WHEN 'CDA_L' THEN 'cda/L' 
            WHEN 'CDITA_L' THEN 'cdta/L' 
            WHEN 'PORCENTAJE' THEN '%' 
            WHEN 'GOTAS_L' THEN 'gotas/L' 
            WHEN 'CC_L' THEN 'cc/L' 
            ELSE mi."dosageUnit"::text 
          END
        ) 
        ORDER BY mi."dosageValue" DESC
      ) 
      FROM "AgrochemicalMixItem" mi 
      JOIN "Agrochemical" ing ON mi."ingredientId" = ing.id 
      WHERE mi."parentMixId" = a.id
    ),
    '[]'::json
  ) AS ingredients
FROM "DosingLog" d 
LEFT JOIN "DosingSchedule" s ON d."scheduleId" = s.id 
LEFT JOIN "FertilizationProgram" fp ON s."fertilizationProgramId" = fp.id 
LEFT JOIN "PhytosanitaryProgram" pp ON s."phytosanitaryProgramId" = pp.id 
LEFT JOIN "Agrochemical" a ON d."agrochemicalId" = a.id 
WHERE d.status IN ('PENDING'::"TaskStatus", 'WAITING_CONFIRMATION'::"TaskStatus") 
  AND d."scheduledAt" <= NOW() + INTERVAL '12 hours' 
ORDER BY d."scheduledAt" ASC 
LIMIT 5;

parameters.query: INSERT INTO "FilterCleaningLog" (id, "cleanedAt", "nextDueAt", notes, "confirmedBy", source, "createdAt") VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), NOW(), (date_trunc('day', NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Caracas') + INTERVAL '2 days' + INTERVAL '8 hours') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Caracas', 'Comando /filter Telegram', '{{ $json.fromUser }}', 'TELEGRAM_BOT', NOW()); UPDATE "Notification" SET "readAt" = NOW(), status = 'READ'::"NotificationStatus" WHERE type = 'MAINTENANCE_REMINDER';
SELECT id, "cleanedAt", "nextDueAt", notes, "confirmedBy", source FROM "FilterCleaningLog" ORDER BY "cleanedAt" DESC LIMIT 1;
